notes: Implemented WP-037 as one full direct art playable integration pass rather than one WP per asset. The scene now uses the approved Phase 4B direct art backgrounds, player avatar, platform tile, collectible, hazard marker, goal marker, and UI panel. Gameplay logic was preserved: game/scripts/player.gd was not modified, and existing Area2D collision, hazard, collectible/progression, goal, timer, retry, movement, and HUD label logic remains intact. Limited visual alignment was performed in scene only: z-index/background washes, AtlasTexture crops for transparent padding, direct art visual nodes, HUD text wash, and section label repositioning. The backgrounds remain visual-only; collision and gameplay objects remain separate. This run does not approve final art direction, production asset usage, launch/public use, QA pass, Learning Card promotion, push, merge, or deployment. Handoff is to a separate QA Work Package.
